description: This file defines a class 'KeyManagementEventHooks' that contains static methods for handling various key management events such as key generation, update, rotation, and deletion in a system that manages API keys. It includes logic for logging, sending notifications via email, and interacting with secret management services.

classes.name: KeyManagementEventHooks
classes.description: A collection of static methods to handle key lifecycle events such as key creation, update, rotation, and deletion, including logging, secret management, and notification tasks.

methods.name: async_key_generated_hook( data: GenerateKeyRequest, response: GenerateKeyResponse, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, litellm_changed_by: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Handles post-process actions after a key is successfully generated, such as sending email notifications, logging audit logs, and storing the key in secret management.

methods.name: async_key_updated_hook( data: UpdateKeyRequest, existing_key_row: Any, response: Any, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, litellm_changed_by: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Handles post-processing after a key update, including audit logging.

methods.name: async_key_rotated_hook( data: Optional[RegenerateKeyRequest], existing_key_row: LiteLLM_VerificationToken, response: GenerateKeyResponse, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, litellm_changed_by: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Handles actions following key rotation, including updating secrets, sending notifications, and audit logging.

methods.name: async_key_deleted_hook( data: KeyRequest, keys_being_deleted: List[LiteLLM_VerificationToken], response: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, litellm_changed_by: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Handles key deletion events, including audit logs and removal from secret manager.

methods.name: _store_virtual_key_in_secret_manager( secret_name: str, secret_token: str, team_id: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Stores a virtual key in the secret manager if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: _rotate_virtual_key_in_secret_manager( current_secret_name: str, new_secret_name: str, new_secret_value: str )
methods.description: Rotates a virtual key in the secret manager if enabled.

methods.name: str _get_secret_name(secret_name: str)
methods.description: Constructs a secret name with the configured prefix for stored virtual keys.

methods.name: _delete_virtual_keys_from_secret_manager( keys_being_deleted: List[LiteLLM_VerificationToken], )
methods.description: Deletes multiple virtual keys from the secret manager.

methods.name: Optional[dict] _get_secret_manager_optional_params( team_id: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Fetches optional parameters for secret manager, such as team-specific settings.

methods.name: bool _is_email_sending_enabled()
methods.description: Checks if email notifications are enabled via enterprise or alerting configurations.

methods.name: _send_key_created_email(response: dict)
methods.description: Sends an email notification when a key is created, if email notifications are enabled.

methods.name: _send_key_rotated_email( response: dict, existing_key_alias: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Sends an email notification when a key is rotated, if email notifications are enabled.
